scope: 20 core and adjacent scholarly records; not an exhaustive archive of all talks, media, supplements, or papers

sources.title: A scalable pipeline for designing reconfigurable organisms
sources.note: Early design-to-embodiment work; the present arena does not reproduce its 3D tissue mechanics.

sources.title: Applications and ethics of computer-designed organisms
sources.note: Applications and ethical framing; no new mechanism is inferred from this commentary.

sources.title: A cellular platform for the development of synthetic living machines
sources.note: Cilia-driven motion, group particle handling, repair and an engineered exposure recorder motivate separate toy assays.

sources.title: Kinematic self-replication in reconfigurable organisms
sources.note: Indexed for coverage. Replication and biological construction are outside this fixed-population simulator.

sources.title: Synthetic living machines: A new window on life
sources.note: Distinguishes early muscle-actuated constructs from more self-organizing ciliated constructs.

sources.title: Life, death, and self: Fundamental questions of primitive cognition viewed through the lens of body plasticity and synthetic organisms
sources.note: Conceptual account of changing embodiment and agency. Online release was in 2020; journal issue is 2021.

sources.title: Technological Approach to Mind Everywhere: an experimentally-grounded framework for understanding diverse bodies and minds
sources.note: Background for designing intervention-based assays; this arena establishes no cognition claim.

sources.title: Synthetic morphology with agential materials
sources.note: Frames multicellular materials as competent components. Full subscription text was not acquired.

sources.title: Biological Robots: Perspectives on an Emerging Interdisciplinary Field
sources.note: Author perspectives on terminology, robotics and developmental biology; not a replication study.

sources.title: Searching in the Dark: Evolving Biobot Swarm Compositions to Efficiently Explore Obstructed Environments
sources.note: Motivates obstruction and mixed-motion comparisons. Publisher full-text retrieval failed; exact algorithmic reproduction is pending.

sources.title: Open problems in synthetic multicellularity
sources.note: Related research agenda. Metadata indexed; no empirical result from this paper is encoded.

sources.title: Basal Xenobot transcriptomics reveals changes and novel control modality in cells freed from organismal influence
sources.note: Reports changed transcriptomes and responses to acoustic stimuli; the arena uses only a generic, uncalibrated stimulus channel.

sources.title: Revealing non-trivial information structures in aneural biological tissues via functional connectivity
sources.note: Analyzes calcium-derived functional connectivity and injury-associated patterns. Causal circuitry and calcium dynamics are not implemented.

sources.title: Identification of brain-like complex information architectures in embryonic tissue of Xenopus laevis organoids
sources.note: Higher-order information organization motivates a future analysis adapter. Statistical resemblance does not establish consciousness.

sources.title: Bidirectional Communication Between Xenobot Cultures? Toward Collective Intelligence Across Diverse Biological Systems
sources.note: Question-mark title retained. This release does not model biological communication or claim semantic exchange.

sources.title: Behavioral, Physiological, and Transcriptional Mechanisms of Memory in a Synthetic Living Construct
sources.note: Reports stimulus-specific changes and memory signatures. Planted latent-state memory is a testing analogue, not a fitted explanation. Direct HTML returned 403.

sources.title: Purinergic signaling disrupts emergent patterns of multicellular coordination in basal Xenobots
sources.note: Related coordination study indexed. Direct HTML returned 403; no pathway-level implementation is supplied.

sources.title: Engineered Living Systems With Self-Organizing Neural Networks: From Anatomy to Behavior and Gene Expression
sources.note: Neurobots contain neural tissue; keep this extension separate from the aneural model. Not implemented.

sources.title: Motile Living Biobots Self-Construct from Adult Human Somatic Progenitor Seed Cells
sources.note: Human-cell anthrobots are a separate platform. Indexed for comparison; not simulated.

sources.title: The Morphological, Behavioral, and Transcriptomic LifeCycle of Anthrobots
sources.note: Related anthrobot follow-up, kept outside the Xenopus behavior model.
